name: Shooting Serenade
value:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        let particles = [];
        let blueStarCount = 0;
        let generation = 0;
        const maxParticles = 600; // Maximum number of particles on the canvas
        const scale = 2; // Scaling factor for the canvas

        function setup() {
            createCanvas(800 * scale, 1000 * scale); // 4:5 aspect ratio, scaled to 2 times its original size
            background(0);

            for (let i = 0; i < maxParticles; i++) {
                let p;
                if (random(1) < 0.05) {
                    p = new ParticleWithNoise(true); // 5% chance of creating a blue star with Perlin noise
                    blueStarCount++;
                } else {
                    p = new StraightLineParticle(false); // 95% chance of creating a particle with straight line motion
                }
                particles.push(p);
            }

            setInterval(addNewParticles, 1000); // Add 200 particles every 2 seconds
        }

        function addNewParticles() {
            for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                let p;
                if (random(1) < 0.05) {
                    p = new ParticleWithNoise(true); // 5% chance of creating a blue star with Perlin noise
                    blueStarCount++;
                } else {
                    p = new StraightLineParticle(false); // 95% chance of creating a particle with straight line motion
                }
                if (particles.length >= maxParticles) {
                    particles.shift(); // Remove the oldest particle if the limit is reached
                }
                particles.push(p);
            }
        }

        function draw() {
            background(0, 0, 0, 25); // Add a small amount of transparency to the background to create a trail effect
            for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                particles[i].update();
                particles[i].show();
            }
        }

        class Particle {
            constructor(isBlue) {
                this.pos = createVector(random(width), random(height));
                this.prevPos = this.pos.copy();
                this.z = random(width);
                this.vel = createVector(random(-0.001, 0.001), random(-0.001, 0.001));
                this.alpha = random(50, 255);
                this.size = random(1, 7) * scale; // Adjusted for smaller circle size and scaled up
                this.originalSize = this.size;
                let brightness = random(240, 255); // Higher brightness for whites and yellows
                let colorValue = isBlue ? random(180, 255) : brightness;
                this.color = color(colorValue, colorValue, isBlue ? random(230, 255) : random(200, 255), this.alpha); // White, yellow, or blue shades
                this.noiseOffsetX = random(1000); // Offset for Perlin noise in X direction
                this.noiseOffsetY = random(1000); // Offset for Perlin noise in Y direction
                this.pulseSpeed = random(0.01, 0.05); // Speed of pulsation
                this.rotate = random(TWO_PI); // Random initial rotation
                this.isBlue = isBlue;
                this.twistFactor = random(0.002, 0.01); // Controls the twist effect
            }

            finished() {
                return this.alpha < 0;
            }

            update() {
                this.prevPos = this.pos.copy();
                this.alpha -= 0.005;
                this.size = this.originalSize + sin(frameCount * this.pulseSpeed) * this.originalSize; // Apply pulsating effect to size
                this.color.setAlpha(this.alpha); // Update the alpha value of the color

                // Add twist effect
                let angle = atan2(this.vel.y, this.vel.x);
                angle += this.twistFactor;
                let speed = this.vel.mag();
                this.vel = p5.Vector.fromAngle(angle);
                this.vel.setMag(speed);
            }

            show() {
                noStroke();
                fill(this.color);
                let size = this.size * (this.z / width);
                let ellipseSize = map(size, 0, this.originalSize * 2, 0, this.originalSize); // Adjust the second parameter (ry) to make the ellipse more circular
                push();
                translate(this.prevPos.x, this.prevPos.y);
                rotate(this.rotate); // Apply rotation
                ellipse(0, 0, size, ellipseSize); // draw the ellipse at the previous position
                pop();
                stroke(this.color);
                line(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.prevPos.x, this.prevPos.y);
            }
        }

        class StraightLineParticle extends Particle {
            constructor(isBlue) {
                super(isBlue);
                this.vel = createVector(random(-0.002, 0.002), random(-0.002, 0.002)); // Move in a straight line
            }

            update() {
                super.update();
                this.pos.sub(p5.Vector.mult(this.vel, this.z)); // move in a straight line
            }
        }

        class ParticleWithNoise extends Particle {
            constructor(isBlue) {
                super(isBlue);
            }

            update() {
                super.update();
                let noiseX = noise(this.noiseOffsetX);
                let noiseY = noise(this.noiseOffsetY);
                this.pos.x += map(noiseX, 0, 1, -1, 1) * 2; // Move the particle based on Perlin noise in X direction
                this.pos.y += map(noiseY, 0, 1, -1, 1) * 2; // Move the particle based on Perlin noise in Y direction
                this.noiseOffsetX += 0.01; // Adjust noise offset for next frame
                this.noiseOffsetY += 0.01; // Adjust noise offset for next frame
            }
        }

        class SpecialParticle extends Particle {
            constructor() {
                super(false);
                this.vel = createVector(random(-0.002, 0.002), random(-0.002, 0.002)); // Move in a straight line
                this.alpha = 255; // Set alpha to maximum to make it brighter
                this.size = random(9, 30) * scale; // Adjusted for larger circle size and scaled up
                this.color = color(random(220, 255), random(220, 255), random(220, 255), this.alpha); // Random white shade
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
